figurative_meaning_en: An object of temptation or lure
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মাছের টোপ দেখিয়ে আমাকে ফাঁদে ফেলতে চায়।
এই অফারটা মাছের টোপের মতো, সাবধানে নাও।
example_sentences_in_english: He is using the bait to trap me into the deal.
This offer is like bait; be careful before biting.
note: Commonly used in contexts involving trickery or allure, drawing from Bengal's riverine fishing traditions.
